Vanilla 1.21.10 SculkPatchFeature.place (fresh javap on the 1.21.10 server-game jar): after the spreader rounds, nextFloat() <= catalystChance with a collision-full block below places SCULK_CATALYST at the origin (flag 3), then extraRareGrowths.sample x origin.offset(nextInt(5)-2, 0, nextInt(5)-2) with air above and a face-sturdy block below places SCULK_SHRIEKER[can_summon=true] (flag 3); the catalyst roll happens BEFORE the growth sample, so the missing tail also shifts the RNG stream.
